statement: Well, I am not too convinced on the shade of kind of black in the background of these, but I think in general it works, and I think I would just add a note saying that, you know, I want the background black to match the color of the corresponding theme. I know due to the image gen, the color may not be the most accurate, but, you know, generally I think this is a pretty good approach, a good start, and I will approve them with the note that the detail coloring and the overall design later may need to be changed, but it's approved.
attributedScope: Accept the four corrected R6-04 Sunrise/Sky/Evening/Night Dark alarm templates as the design starting point; require matching corresponding existing theme background/color roles and retain later detailed coloring/visual polish flexibility.
supersedes: Pending replacement-pixel review in living documents only. The original plain R6-04 remains rejected; historical A22/A23 evidence and scope stay unchanged.
conditions: Owner condition (A24): the full-page background and elevated reading surfaces must use the corresponding existing atmosphere/appearance's shared semantic color roles. Match the approved theme instead of adopting an independent alarm-specific black or sampling a generated PNG shade. Exact detailed coloring and later visual polish remain open.
Retain one shared component hierarchy/geometry and native Stop/Snooze semantics; generic pre-first-unlock content remains private-safe.
These are accepted direction/layout references, not immutable final production artwork, exact sampled shades or final visual polish.
limits: Four Dark replacement templates only; all four-atmosphere Light/Dark component support remains an inherited requirement, not approval of unrendered pixel combinations.
No P04/P07/P08 feature execution, exact persistence/capture/migration/default/time policy decision or milestone completion.
No actual RN/Compose, accessibility, Direct Boot, scheduling or physical-device verification implied.
